subject.title: feat(fleet): harden create, port allocation, drift visibility, and operator docs

question: Should `openclaw security audit` explicitly direct multi-user operators to the experimental one-cell-per-tenant Fleet model?
rationale: This changes user-facing guidance about the supported tenant-isolation boundary, and tests cannot determine whether the security owner endorses an experimental Fleet surface as the recommended deployment path.

options.title: Approve bounded Fleet guidance
options.body: Keep the link after confirming that both the audit text and destination page clearly preserve the trusted host and operator boundary.

options.title: Keep the guidance generic
options.body: Remove the Fleet-specific recommendation and retain separate-gateway guidance until Fleet is formally endorsed as a security path.

options.title: Pause the combined bundle
options.body: Hold the PR if the security direction is not ready for a product-level endorsement.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded Fleet guidance
recommendation.body: Keep the link after confirming that both the audit text and destination page clearly preserve the trusted host and operator boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the changed security-audit implementation to this team, making it the best available owner for the trust-boundary wording decision.
